phases.name: Major functions

phases.exit_gate: Every tracked major workflow meets its documented acceptance criteria; unresolved major gaps or blockers stay open.

phases.name: Minor functions
phases.scope: Secondary tools, options, variations and supporting workflows beyond those needed to close major functions.
phases.exit_gate: Every tracked minor function meets its documented acceptance criteria.

phases.name: Final details
phases.scope: Remaining cosmetic polish, fine alignment and small interaction refinements after functional scope is complete.
phases.entry_gate: All major and minor functions closed.

dependency_rule: A smaller change required to make a major function complete, usable or correct belongs to that major function and may be implemented with it. Optional polish does not jump the queue.
definition_of_closed: Working end-to-end native Swift/macOS behavior, with the UI and Photoshop factory menu/shortcut integration needed for that function.
Shared Photato API support plus the corresponding Adobe-compatible operation where the published contract defines it; documented schemas, state, availability and errors.
Relevant automated and live workflow validation, including undo/redo, invalid or busy requests and persistence as applicable.
Independent Photoshop comparisons for relevant output/interaction claims; known failures and unqualified requirements remain open. Passing native tests alone does not establish parity.
Updated development record, evidence, command coverage and current plan.
